title_zh: 约定取回挂环并换上备用窗帘

scenario.label_zh: 发现窗帘撕裂后约定先取回挂环再更换窗帘
scenario.goal_zh: 说明窗帘破损和挂环位置并约定轻取窗帘后改用备用品

context_zh: 室友 Rowan 与 Ella 查看窗帘上缘的破口和掉落的挂环，窗帘杆仍固定在原位。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: There's a tear near the top of the curtain, and the fabric is caught behind the rod.

sentences.speaker: Ella
sentences.text: Don't pull hard; that could rip it further.

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: I can see a loose ring on the floor beside the chair.

sentences.speaker: Ella
sentences.text: I'll retrieve it. Can we take the curtain down carefully and use the spare one?

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: Yes. Let's leave the damaged curtain on the table and look at the tear properly later.

sentences.speaker: Ella
sentences.text: Fine. I'll collect the ring first.
